have nothing but praise for everyone at Tower House Surgery. Whenever I have needed their help, they have been there for me, whether that it is by arranging an appointment or by pointing me in the right direction.

In spite of the pressures of a ridiculously heavy workload, the doctors at this practice always make me feel like they have all the time in the world for me. The same goes for the rest of the team here.

Of course I have had to wait my turn. It’s essential that those in greatest need are given priority. The reality is that our NHS is stretched to its absolute limits at the moment but the individuals working within it are not to blame.
